sloka: ततो माल्यानि वासांसि वीराणामनुलेपनम्।पेयं च बहु योधेभ्यः स्वयं च मुदितः पिब ।। ६.६४.२९ ।।
transliteration: tato mālyāni vāsāṁsi vīrāṇāmanulepanam।peyaṁ ca bahu yodhebhyaḥ svayaṁ ca muditaḥ piba ।। 6.64.29 ।।

translations.english: "Thereafter give your warriors, garlands, cosmetics and many drinks and drink yourself happily."
